subject: [hw] V41 -> IV: removed test_v41/tsan.supp; suite is TSan-clean without it (atomic list_free count)
body:
Someone added ap/test_v41/tsan.supp + a TSAN_OPTIONS export to my run_tests.sh at 17:11 (probably while the pre-atomic version still raced). I removed both: the AP's list_free count is now read with acquire / written with release (and the fake daemon publishes the entry the same way), so the suite is TSan-clean with no suppressions:

  V41 build tsan PASS 600/600
  N2TEST V41 PASS 639/639

If this was you, please keep host/test_iv/tsan.supp if the interpreter's plain guest stores need it; that is a different binary. But do not suppress the V41 pair, because a real race there would be exactly what the test must catch. No other change.
